svg.title: AI observability architecture
svg.desc: A single request is traced through authorization, retrieval, model call, validation and business action. Telemetry and evaluations feed six signal areas: model performance, cost, response quality, retrieval effectiveness, security and business outcomes, used for dashboards, regression evaluations, incident response and business reviews.
